newsitem.title: USA: Xpedite Systems says buyout offer expires.
newsitem.headline: Xpedite Systems says buyout offer expires.

text.p: Xpedite Systems Inc, a developer of fax and electronic mail distribution services, said Friday members of its management team and their partners failed to extend their offer to buy the company.
Xpedite said it plans to continue to explore strategic alternatives for enhancing stockholder value.
On Thursday, the company said the managment team and its partners had agreed to extend an offer to buy the company until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on that day.
The original buyout offer of $22.50 per share was made February 7 by Xpedite manangers, along with UBS Partners LLC, an affiliate of Union Bank of Switzerland and Fenway Partners Inc.
On Monday, the offer was extended to July 16.

The offer was extended again after Xpedite agreed not to solicit or take any action to facilite any further offer to acquire it, and to reimburse the buyout group's reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred from July 12 until July 17.
